embedded_and_generated_inputs.name: $OUT_DIR/bindgen.rs
embedded_and_generated_inputs.kind: generated Rust from an immutable registry package member

facts: `main` reads `OUT_DIR`; for the `bundled` feature the selected branch is `build_bundled::main` (build.rs `main` lines 69-118, bundled branch at 106, `build_bundled` at 130).

`build_bundled::main` copies `sqlite3/bindgen_bundled_version.rs` to `$OUT_DIR/bindgen.rs` (unless `buildtime_bindgen`), emits `cargo:include=<manifest>/sqlite3`, and declares `cargo:include`, `cargo:rerun-if-changed=sqlite3/sqlite3.c` and `cargo:rerun-if-changed=sqlite3/wasm32-wasi-vfs.c` (build.rs lines 147-149).
It compiles `sqlite3/sqlite3.c` through `cc::Build` with fixed `-D` feature flags plus `-I <manifest>/sqlite3` (build.rs lines 150-186, `cfg.compile` at 334).
The `bundled` path never calls pkg-config or vcpkg; those are used only by `build_linked` (`find_sqlite` at 450, pkg-config probes at 473/490, `try_vcpkg` at 511).

Resolves the compiler/archiver/linker with target-qualified precedence (`target_envs` at 4296, `getenv_with_target_prefixes` at 4314, `envflags` `CFLAGS`/`CXXFLAGS`/`ARFLAGS`) over target/unprefixed `CC`,`CFLAGS`,`AR`,`ARFLAGS`,`CXX`,`CXXFLAGS`,`NVCC`,`CXXSTDLIB`,`RUSTC_WRAPPER` (3544),`RUSTC_LINKER` (3939); reads `CARGO_CFG_TARGET_FEATURE` (2229,2532), `CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS` (2781,3240), `CARGO_TRIM_PATHS_SCOPE/REMAP` (2801-2804), `OUT_DIR` (4230), `NUM_JOBS` (job_token.rs 236).
Executes compilers/archivers/linkers and `rustc` (target/parser.rs 594-609, target/llvm.rs 279-296; command_helpers.rs `spawn` 496, `Command` at tool.rs 134/242/413).
On Apple it consults `SDKROOT` (4373), falls back to `xcrun` (4405,4458), and adds the deployment-target flag (`MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET` at 4530; target/apple.rs).
It writes and compiles temporary flag-check translation units, falling back to a tempfile (lib.rs 1482/1503,1515-1540).

Compiled as libsqlite3-sys build-dependencies: the pinned Cargo.lock lists `libsqlite3-sys` dependencies `[cc, pkg-config, vcpkg]`, consistent with its `default = [min_sqlite_version_3_34_1]` enabling `pkg-config` and `vcpkg`.

Neither is invoked by the `bundled` branch of build.rs. pkg-config would run a `pkg-config` process and read `PKG_CONFIG*`; vcpkg would read `VCPKG_ROOT`/`OUT_DIR` files. Their runtime reads are therefore not part of this workflow unless a non-bundled feature is selected.
Only compile-time environment use is `env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION_PATCH")` (src/lib.rs line 101); the macro emits a private module ident `__private<patch>`.
No `std::fs`, `std::process`, `env::var`, `include!` or `OUT_DIR` use anywhere under its 29 read leaves. Proc-macro behaviour is token-only within this crate.

No `std::fs`, `std::process`, `env::var`, `include_str!`, `OUT_DIR` or `option_env!` use under its 11 read leaves. Derive output is token-only; the `#[schemars(schema_with=...)]` paths are evaluated in the consuming crate, not read by the macro.
Dependencies per the pinned lock are `proc-macro2`, `quote`, `serde_derive_internals 0.29.1`, `syn 2.0.119`.
`proc-macro2 1.0.107`, `quote 1.0.47`, `syn 2.0.119`, `syn 3.0.6`, `serde_derive_internals 0.29.1`, `serde_core 1.0.229` and `thiserror-impl 2.0.21` are not among the six permit-ted roots.
The owning contract states proc-macro2 performs rustc compile probes under OUT_DIR and serde/serde_core write versioned private modules and query rustc; that behaviour was NOT re-observed here.

finite_acquisition_package.name: One read-only accepted native/tool input-closure receipt for the selected core-test workflow
finite_acquisition_package.rationale: The behavior audit shows the registry/generated side is mechanically coverable, while native/tool/SDK, effective configuration, enabled graph and the accepted issuer are the blocking seams. This one package closes the largest independently reviewable gap without Cargo.
concrete_inputs: Complete per-file correspondence manifest for libsqlite3-sys 0.38.2 (all 26 files, 4 directories) retained by the existing private streaming verifier, with the archive SHA-256 and lock checksum. No legacy `verify` call, no 58-package replay.

Native input enumeration for the bundled build: sqlite3/sqlite3.c (9,507,037), sqlite3/sqlite3.h (690,725), sqlite3/sqlite3ext.h (39,175), and the generated $OUT_DIR/bindgen.rs association; `sqlite3/wasm32-wasi-vfs.c` only if the wasm feature is enabled.

Installed toolchain/SDK receipt: cargo 1.97.1/c980f4866, rustc 1.97.1/8bab26f4f, sysroot, clang/cc/ar/ld absolute identity+digest, SDK 27.0 header/framework roots, and a no-replacement agreement for the lease.
